skills.name: cleaning-existing-codebase
skills.description: Use when the user asks to "clean up", "apply repo-hygiene to", or "fix the hygiene of" an existing codebase — orchestrates the other hygiene skills in a phased, reviewable order rather than firing a 200-file mega-diff
headings: 4. Use the Other Hygiene Skills as Tools
skills.description_zh: 对已有代码库实施 Repo Hygiene 清理，按可审阅的阶段编排其他整理技能，避免将大量文件变更集中成一次巨型差异。

skills.name: gating-commits
skills.description: Use when about to commit, merge, or push — runs verification (tests, typecheck, lint), confirms focus, and checks sibling hygiene (docs, tests, docstrings) BEFORE the commit lands, so "user said commit" doesn't bypass quality
headings: What if the Repo Has No Verification Setup?
skills.description_zh: 在提交、合并或推送前执行测试、类型检查与 lint，确认变更聚焦，并检查文档、测试和 docstring 等配套内容，使提交请求仍经过质量门禁。

skills.name: keeping-docs-fresh
skills.description: Use when changing a public API surface — renamed export, changed signature/return type, new or removed flag/route/env var, schema migration, deprecation — before committing, so README, docs/, CHANGELOG, and inline references stay coherent with the code
headings: What Counts as a Public API Change
Old symbol name across docs + non-source files
Broader sweep including inline comments in code
skills.description_zh: 在导出、签名、返回类型、参数、路由、环境变量、Schema 或弃用等公开 API 变化后、提交前同步 README、docs、CHANGELOG 与内联引用，使文档和代码一致。

skills.name: keeping-files-small
skills.description: Use when about to add lines to an existing source file, when a single file passes ~400 lines, or when proposing where to put new code — prevents files from sprawling into multi-concern god-modules
skills.description_zh: 在现有源文件增加代码、文件超过约 400 行或决定新代码位置时检查拆分方式，防止单文件积累多个职责并不断膨胀。

skills.name: orienting-to-repo
skills.description: Use when starting substantive work in an unfamiliar repo, before diving into task-specific grep or edits — especially when the task touches business logic, public API, build, or infra, or you don't yet know the repo's purpose, stack, conventions, or layout
skills.description_zh: 在陌生仓库开展实质工作前了解其目的、技术栈、约定与布局，尤其适用于业务逻辑、公开 API、构建或基础设施变更，再开展具体搜索和修改。

skills.name: testing-new-code
skills.description: Use when adding or modifying business logic, branching code, public API, or fixing a bug in a repo using repo-hygiene — tests for the new code paths must exist before the change is committed, not "later" or "if the user asks
headings: When NOT to Use (Genuine Triviality Only)
What if the Repo Has No Test Infra?
skills.description_zh: 在采用 Repo Hygiene 的仓库新增或修改业务逻辑、分支逻辑、公开 API 或修复缺陷时，为新增路径建立测试，并在提交前完成。

skills.name: using-repo-hygiene
skills.description: Use when starting any conversation in a repo — establishes the repo-hygiene skill set and the moments each sub-skill applies
skills.description_zh: 作为 Repo Hygiene 技能集入口，说明各子技能及其在仓库工作流程中适用的时机。

skills.name: writing-commit-messages
skills.description: Use when drafting any commit message — sets format (imperative subject under 72 chars, explanatory body when the why isn't obvious from the diff) and prevents the "Fix X" one-liner reflex for non-trivial fixes
skills.description_zh: 规范提交信息写法：使用少于 72 字符的祈使式标题，变更动机无法从差异看出时补充正文，避免复杂修复仅写笼统的一行标题。

skills.name: writing-docstrings
skills.description: Use when writing or modifying any function, method, class, or source file in a repo using repo-hygiene — public API, internal helpers, and new files all require docstrings; only one-line lambdas and trivial accessors are excluded
headings: What Earns a Docstring Its Place
skills.description_zh: 在采用 Repo Hygiene 的仓库编写或修改函数、方法、类及源文件时补充 docstring，覆盖公开 API、内部辅助函数和新文件；单行 lambda 与简单访问器除外。
